name: Sakurai Saki
source:
The only member of the handicrafts  club that is a junior. She rivals Hikari in clumsiness. She is a troublemaker like Harumi, although she doesn't have any bad intent. She is always cheerful and smiling. She is from a fatherless family so to help with finances she has a part-time job. She respects Hajime because he can easily make crafts.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/タペストリー_-you_will_meet_yourself-]Wikipedia[/url]]
